resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 5508 ft and idahofirelookouts.com gives 5502 ft. The story reports both and does not choose one.

The FFLA list gives 47.90502, -116.09091, which is the coordinate pair in our record. The idaho_fl source gives 47.88742, -116.09434, about 2 km away. No page read says which is right, so the story does not place the site by coordinates.

notes_for_editor: Build year, 1955 loss and the forest are agreed across all four sources. The record's coordinates come from FFLA, while idaho_fl gives a pair about 2 km away; neither page says which is right, so check the map before publishing. The 9.1 m height is the 30-foot pole figure converted; no source gives a separate height. No staffing is documented in any source read, so the story leaves staffing out. The brief's events were empty; built 1934 and destroyed 1955 are added here. Access is not established beyond the hike-in label, so no access level is set.
